title: Transcode e2e scenarios fail in full gate runs on a loaded machine; each passes 5 of 5 alone
notes: Not the BL-100 stall. The three: the dashboard card and Playback info panel (timed out after 44 s, panel empty); jellyfin-web after a segment fails, answered 500, once (timed out waiting for the player to ask for the failing segment, 65 s); a slow re-encode shared by three workers (browser closed after 92 s, then the gate printed no shard line). Host had about 2 GB free RAM. Product owner asks (evidence): does any of them fail in the merge queue or on CI's runners? Second sighting (JS-145 verify, D-023): the 500-segment scenario timed out in a full gate run, with Postgres refusing connections near the end of the gate; 5 of 5 alone. Promote if it fails on the merge queue, a third time locally, or if jellyscale itself (not the test stack) is shown to have used up the connections (then with JS-092). D-042: if the e2e scenario that failed the merge queue on 2026-11-20 is one of these three, the promote rule is met; it is then JS-155's seventh sighting and this item becomes promoted. If it is another scenario, this item is unchanged. Closed at the pivot: Tied to a Jellyfin route, a Jellyfin app, jellyfin-web, Quick Connect or Jellyfin's tooling, all removed at the cutover (D-107, D-109, rule 3).
